Cascadia Mono Nerd Font v3.5.1

Source: https://github.com/ryanoasis/nerd-fonts/releases/tag/v3.5.1
Release archive: CascadiaMono.tar.xz
Archive SHA-256: e4fe0248bbe2558e907d26b55ed287403972f946239a4ea3f7a8afd3365ad6ba
Bundled file: CaskaydiaMonoNerdFontMono-Regular.ttf
Bundled file SHA-256: 0bc1e80eb7d1c0a1debb433a21da6e686b15556e1d54fcfe47f87f7379276830

The release combines the Cascadia Mono base font with the Nerd Fonts symbol sets.
The release README attributes the included icon sets as follows:

- Codicons 0.0.45 — CC BY 4.0
- Devicons 2.17.0 — MIT
- extraglyphs — MIT
- Font Awesome 6.5.1 — CC BY 4.0
- Font Awesome Extension 0.0.3 — MIT
- Font Logos 1.3.0 — unlicensed
- MaterialDesign (2022-10-06) — Apache 2.0
- Octicons 18.3.0 — MIT
- Seti and original 0.8.1 — MIT
- Pomicons 1.001 — OFL 1.1 with Reserved Font Name
- Powerline Extra 1.200 — MIT
- Powerline Symbols 1.000 — MIT
- Power Symbols IEC (2015-02) — MIT
- Weather Icons 2.0.10 — OFL 1.1

The Cascadia Mono license shipped in the official release archive is included as LICENSE-CASCADIA-MONO.txt. The Nerd Fonts project license is included as LICENSE-NERD-FONTS.txt. Full project licensing and source attribution remain available at https://github.com/ryanoasis/nerd-fonts/.
